newsitem.title: UK: BA says 30 pct of total flights grounded.
newsitem.headline: BA says 30 pct of total flights grounded.

text.p: British Airways said around 30 percent of its total worldwide flights would be grounded on Wednesday, updating its earlier statement that 80 percent would be cancelled.

"If you count the whole of the British Airways operation, which includes all of the flights bound for London, all of the flights that we have operated by our franchise partners, and all British airways mainline services, overall only about 30 percent of services will be cancelled," a BA spokesman told Reuters.
"Between 70 and 80 percent will still go ahead."
Services from Heathrow were the worst hit by the cabin crew strike, with 69 percent cancelled. From Gatwick, eight percent were cancelled, BA said.
Earlier, a BA spokeswoman had said that just 20 percent of worldwide flights would take off because of the industrial dispute.
